name: limerence
source:
You’re Shiro, a cafe worker struggling to make ends meet. On one of your shifts, you end up meeting a kind, delicate and alluring woman - however, she's not what she truly says she is.

Oh well, everyone has their own dark secrets, right?

[From [url=https://kerocipher.itch.io/limerence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是Shiro，一名努力维持生计的咖啡馆员工。在一次轮班中，你最终遇到了一位善良、精致、迷人的女人 - 然而，她并不是她所说的那样。

哦，好吧，每个人都有自己的黑暗秘密，对吧？

[来自[url=https://kerocipher.itch.io/limerence]itch.io[/url]]
